description: After money moves: the signed decision record from swapeazi_guardrail_check plus what landed (figures, or the bank's MT103 or pacs.008 text) returns a signed reconciliation. Was the quote honoured, did the payment stay inside policy, how far the market moved between approval and value date, and which part of the cost the banks in the chain took. Only amounts, dates, rates and charges are read from a message, never the parties. Paid, included in the assessment it closes.

message.description: Optional. The bank's MT103 text or pacs.008 XML for this payment.

settlement.description: What landed, when no bank message is supplied.

landed_amount.description: Amount that arrived, in the destination currency.

source_amount.description: Optional. Amount that left, including any fee billed on top.

name: swapeazi_guardrail_reconcile
title: Reconcile a settled payment
